# v1.0.1 · MIT license

The package and its repository are now released under the **MIT** license
([LICENSE](https://github.com/pengfeis/dsh-super-search/blob/main/LICENSE)), so it
can be installed, modified and redistributed freely with attribution.

No behavior changes: this release is identical to v1.0.0 apart from the license,
the `license` field in `package.json`, and the documentation updates.

## Install

```bash
# agent
plugin_manager install_bundle target=git+https://github.com/pengfeis/dsh-super-search.git#v1.0.1

# CLI
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add git+https://github.com/pengfeis/dsh-super-search.git
```

The attached `dsh-super-search-1.0.1.tgz` (and its sha256) installs offline.
